comment.body:
Candidate rule proposed ## Reproduced symptom Reproduced — Issue #⁠245596 reports the Shoper cookie-consent dialog on www⁠.4motos.pl ("Dbamy o Twoją prywatność") plus its dark page mask; the reporter profile reproduced both. A domain-scoped element-hiding rule for the overlay and its mask was validated in the extension (symptom resolved, page integrity intact, no remaining instances), so I propose it for the Cookie Notices filter. ## Rule `4motos.pl##.consents__wrapper, .consents__mask` ## Executor and version Pinned prebuilt release v5.5.2.3 ## Policy rationale The report is a cookie-notice annoyance (a first-party Shoper consent dialog plus its page mask), which the AdGuard Cookie Notices filter is meant to handle; the run instruction closes no rule category for it:⁠ it is not the site's own advertising, not a paywall, and not an anti-adblock wall. No anti-adblock, malware or paywall policy rule applies; the page shows a plain consent overlay. ## Place in the list [AnnoyancesFilter/Cookies/sections/cookies_specific.txt](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/9941b7d3307202ca616dd93a3e5bddd9e5997ffd/AnnoyancesFilter/Cookies/sections/cookies_specific.txt) At the end of the file. ## Screenshots
Without and with the rule | Without the rule | With the rule | |---|---| | | |
## Artifacts https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/actions/runs/40604415016 Automated analysis against filters at `9941b7d`. Posted by a filters agent; a maintainer reviews before anything is merged.

issue.title: www.eneba.com
issue.body:
### Issue URL (Incorrect Blocking)
https://www.eneba.com/steam-mechabellum-pc-steam-key-global?af_id=keyfinder

### What product do you use?
Other ad blocker: AdBlocker Ultimate on Firefox, whose Ultimate Privacy Filter carries the same rule. The rule comes from the AdGuard Tracking Protection filter, so AdGuard users are affected the same way.

### What type of problem have you encountered?
Website doesn't work properly: Eneba's partner referral cookie is removed, so purchases are not credited to the partner who sent the buyer.

### Description
The generic rule `$cookie=af_id` in the AdGuard Tracking Protection filter removes the first-party cookie `af_id` on www.eneba.com.

Eneba's affiliate links carry `?af_id=<partner>`. When the page loads, Eneba's own script sets `af_id=<partner>` on www.eneba.com for 30 days, and that cookie is what credits the partner when the buyer checks out. If the cookie is removed, the referral is lost. Nothing cross-site is involved: it is Eneba's own cookie on its own domain.

The rule sits right next to `$cookie=afUserId`, so it looks aimed at AppsFlyer's cookies. On eneba.com the same name is used for something else.

### Steps to reproduce
1. Without the filter, open https://www.eneba.com/steam-mechabellum-pc-steam-key-global?af_id=keyfinder
2. The page sets the cookie `af_id=keyfinder` on www.eneba.com, expiring in 30 days.
3. With the AdGuard Tracking Protection filter on, `$cookie=af_id` removes that cookie, so Eneba has nothing to credit at checkout.

A real case: on 26 Oct 2026 a buyer on Firefox with AdBlocker Ultimate clicked our link at 18:17 UTC and ordered at 18:18 UTC. Eneba did not credit the referral. Our other Eneba referrals from browsers without this rule are credited normally.

### Suggested fix
```
@@||eneba.com^$cookie=af_id
```

### Disclosure
We run keyfinder.gg, a game key price comparison site, and we are an Eneba affiliate, so this affects us directly. It also affects every creator and site in Eneba's partner program whose audience uses AdGuard or AdBlocker Ultimate.

issue.title: www.eneba.com
issue.body:
### Issue URL (Incorrect Blocking)
https://www.eneba.com/steam-mechabellum-pc-steam-key-global?af_id=keyfinder

### What product do you use?
Other ad blocker: AdBlocker Ultimate on Firefox, whose Ultimate Privacy Filter carries the same rule. The rule comes from the AdGuard Tracking Protection filter, so AdGuard users are affected the same way.

### What type of problem have you encountered?
Website doesn't work properly: Eneba's partner referral cookie is removed, so purchases are not credited to the partner who sent the buyer.

### Description
The generic rule `$cookie=af_id` in the AdGuard Tracking Protection filter removes the first-party cookie `af_id` on www.eneba.com.

Eneba's affiliate links carry `?af_id=<partner>`. When the page loads, Eneba's own script sets `af_id=<partner>` on www.eneba.com for 30 days, and that cookie is what credits the partner when the buyer checks out. If the cookie is removed, the referral is lost. Nothing cross-site is involved: it is Eneba's own cookie on its own domain.

The rule sits right next to `$cookie=afUserId`, so it looks aimed at AppsFlyer's cookies. On eneba.com the same name is used for something else.

### Steps to reproduce
1. Without the filter, open https://www.eneba.com/steam-mechabellum-pc-steam-key-global?af_id=keyfinder
2. The page sets the cookie `af_id=keyfinder` on www.eneba.com, expiring in 30 days.
3. With the AdGuard Tracking Protection filter on, `$cookie=af_id` removes that cookie, so Eneba has nothing to credit at checkout.

A real case: on 26 Oct 2026 a buyer on Firefox with AdBlocker Ultimate clicked our link at 18:17 UTC and ordered at 18:18 UTC. Eneba did not credit the referral. Our other Eneba referrals from browsers without this rule are credited normally.

### Suggested fix
```
@@||eneba.com^$cookie=af_id
```

### Disclosure
We run keyfinder.gg, a game key price comparison site, and we are an Eneba affiliate, so this affects us directly. It also affects every creator and site in Eneba's partner program whose audience uses AdGuard or AdBlocker Ultimate.

<!-- adguard-filters-agent:report {"schemaVersion":1,"revisionDigest":"4a1748b9a14ea9dd891e1011ee428dcf8e511e7fccf2e9d164915d4752b9c771"} -->
Analysis-only findings, no verified change

## Reproduced symptom

Indeterminate — On the reported Eneba URL the alleged breakage does not reproduce:⁠ with AdGuard Tracking Protection active the page renders intact, the affiliate referral is still captured (the 302 rewrites ?af_id= into utm_medium/utm_source and the site stores it in localStorage), eneba.com's other first-party cookies survive, and no af_id cookie was ever observed — even in the experiment phase where no rule applied. No rule change is supported, so the reporter's requested `@@||eneba.com^$cookie=af_id` exception is not proposed.

## Missing information

- No unfiltered control session in adguard_cli mode; reporter's third-party filter unavailable: In the locked adguard_cli environment every browser session routes through the filtering proxy:⁠ a session launched with extension:⁠"none" already applied AdGuard Tracking Protection filter rules (engine "AdGuard CLI", list id 3), and launch_browser refuses a "settings" object for extension:⁠"none", so no unfiltered baseline can be captured. For a report whose only symptom is a cookie being removed, that means the cookie's presence without filtering cannot be observed. Additionally, the engine's get_applied_rules states that it never logs the text of rules that modify a request ($cookie among them), and search_rules indexes only the URL portion of network rules, so the accused generic `$cookie=af_id` line could not be located in the repository or confirmed in the applied list. filterBaseline also reports skippedSources:⁠ {"kind":⁠"unresolved_name","reportedName":⁠"Ultimate Privacy Filter"} — the reporter's third-party list is not inspectable here.

## Artifacts

https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/actions/runs/40615468340

Analysis-only findings, no verified change

## Reproduced symptom

Indeterminate — The reported Yandex 403 page on n1960529.yclients.ru did not reproduce:⁠ with the AdGuard CLI filtering proxy (HTTPS interception active) the site loaded twice with HTTP 200, redirected to its booking menu and rendered fully, and no repository rule targets yclients.ru. No filter rule change is needed for this report; the 403 most plausibly comes from outside the filter lists, which I could not test.

## Missing information

- Reporter's non-official sources (EasyList Cookie, 3 blocklists, 7 AnnoyancesFilter custom subscriptions) cannot be loaded in this environment: The adguard_cli baseline advertises only official AdGuard filters (1,2,3,11,17,18,20,21,25) and lists 12 reporter sources under skippedSources (EasyList Cookie List, Online Malicious URL Blocklist, Phishing URL Blocklist, Scam Blocklist by DurableNapkin, uBlock Origin - Badware risks, and the seven AnnoyancesFilter/Popups/sections/*.txt custom subscriptions). No tool offered a way to load those sources, so the reporter's exact filter set - in particular the antiadblock/popups subscriptions and EasyList Cookie - could not be reproduced. Also, the reporter's HTTPS-filtering path runs inside AdGuard for Android's own network stack on Firefox Preview, which no available environment reproduces exactly; no geographic proxy backend is available, so an egress-IP-dependent server response cannot be tested.

### Issue URL (Incorrect Blocking) [https://rutube.ru/](https://adguardteam.github.io/AnonymousRedirect/redirect.html?url=https%3A%2F%2Frutube.ru%2F) ### Comment > У меня Яндекс ТВ Станция Бейсик, и я особо не задумывался о блокировке рекламы раньше, потому что у меня максимальная подписка Яндекс Плюс, но в последнее время я начал смотреть один сериал не на своём Windows планшете Surface Go, а на ТВ Станции. «Анатомия страсти». Суть в том, что сериала нет на КиноПоиске, но система Яндекса позволяет смотреть его с Rutube (такое со многими сериалами, их можно найти на Rutube или в «ВК Видео»), при этом не скачивая приложение Rutube. Используется системный видеоплеер Яндекса, который берёт видео с Rutube. И там всё время воспроизведение прерывается вставками видеорекламы. В конце концов мне это надоело, и я попробовал настроить на роутере AdGuard DNS, так как сам телевизор этого не позволяет сделать. Однако это не помогло. Теперь попробовал установить AdGuard для Android TV, он отлично решил проблему и заблокировал рекламу. Однако появилась новая проблема. Яндекс ТВ Станция и её плеер не запоминают серию, на которой я остановился, если включён AdGuard, приходится выбирать её вручную, а плеер помнит последнюю серию, которую я смотрел без AdGuard. Первый скриншот с AdGuard, второй без него. ### Screenshots

comment.body:
I had initially tested on MacOS Safari and Chrome, FireFox for checking leftover is disappear. 

It also works on iOS Safari. I've tested with following rules after received your question. 

```adblock
! disable the delete rules
mail.yahoo.com#@%#//scriptlet('set-constant', 'AppBootstrapData.config.adshieldAdblockRecovery', 'false', '', '', 'true')
mail.yahoo.com#@%#//scriptlet('set-constant', 'AppState.reduxState.features.adshieldAdblockRecovery', 'false', '', '', 'true')
@@||mail.yahoo.com$replace=/("adshield(Adblock|NativeAd)Recovery"):true/\$1:false/
mail.yahoo.com#@%#//scriptlet('set-constant', 'AppState.reduxState.features.adshieldAdblockRecovery', 'false')
mail.yahoo.com#@%#//scriptlet('set-constant', 'AppState.reduxState.features.ads', 'false')
mail.yahoo.com#@%#//scriptlet('set-constant', 'AppState.reduxState.features.pencilAd', 'false')
! merged rules
mail.yahoo.com#%#//scriptlet('trusted-replace-node-text', 'script', '/App(State|BootstrapData) = /', '/"(ads|pencilAd|secondPencilAd|thirdPencilAd|infinitePencilAd|searchAd|secondSearchAd|additionalPencilAdWithSearchAd|sameSearchAdOnSecondPencil|adshieldAdblockRecovery|adshieldNativeAdRecovery)":true/g', '"$1":false')
```

comment.body:
<!-- adguard-filters-agent:report {"schemaVersion":1,"revisionDigest":"8243533e314e998398bd3a9bcb961f72a97a7800e798d2afcf633a5aedbaed55"} -->
The filter policy recommends closing without a rule

## Reproduced symptom

Reproduced the in-player pre-roll on www⁠.yifan.tv with the reporter's own AdGuard profile, but it is served entirely by the site's own ad platform (ad orders from ppt.yifan.tv/play/o, creatives from pptstatic.yifan.tv, played inside the site's own player stream) with no third-party ad network involved, and blocking that order endpoint did not remove it. Under the run instruction's policy ("The site's own advertising (first-party ads):⁠ no rule; recommend closing") no rule should be written, so this report is recommended for closing.

## Still visible after the rule

- VG-PLAYER#⁠main-player / 广告 / HONOR Magic9 — The main video player shows an in-player pre-roll advertisement:⁠ a HONOR Magic9 brand creative occupies the right portion of the player, with the 广告 label visible at the lower right of the player area.
- Main video player (VG-PLAYER#⁠main-player), right half of the player area — In-player pre-roll ad creative:⁠ HONOR Magic9 series brand advertisement (product images of phones and camera lens, '荣耀Magic9 系列' and HONOR logo) filling the right portion of the video player, with a small '广告' label at the bottom-right corner of the player frame.

## Executor and version

Pinned prebuilt release v5.5.2.3

## Policy rationale

Run instruction, filter policy:⁠ "The site's own advertising (first-party ads):⁠ no rule; recommend closing." The KB filter policy states the same rule:⁠ "The site’s own advertising should not be deliberately blocked. However, it should not be unblocked if the blocking is caused by general filtering rules" (AdguardTeam/KnowledgeBase docs/general/ad-filtering/filter-policy.md). Every advertising request on the reported play page is first-party to the site:⁠ the ad order comes from https:⁠//ppt.yifan.tv/play/o, the banner creatives from pptstatic.yifan.tv/upload/video/*.jpg, the ad configuration from the site's own localStorage key ggs_20xx, and the in-player pre-roll is played inside the site's own player (VG-PLAYER#⁠main-player) from the site's own HLS stream on sss111-e1.pipecdn.vip. No third-party advertising network request exists in either captured session; the only third-party ad host, pagead2.googlesyndication.com, is already redirected by the AdGuard Base filter and is used by the site only for its own ad-block probe (window.detectAdBlock()). The advertising is therefore the site's own (first-party) advertising, which this repository's policy excludes from deliberate blocking; recommend closing the report instead of writing a rule.

## Missing information

- Filter policy does not define "the site's own advertising (first-party ads)": The run instruction's policy bullet "The site's own advertising (first-party ads):⁠ no rule; recommend closing" and the KB filter-policy bullet "The site's own advertising should not be deliberately blocked" are the only statements available, and neither defines the term. lookup_rule_guidance(topic=policy) returns only that summary bullet; the "Ad blocking filters → Terminology" section of the same document (which would define first-party/site advertising) is never served, even when queried with "Terminology first-party advertising". This run needed that definition to decide whether a pre-roll brand advertisement (HONOR Magic9) delivered entirely by the site's own ad platform (ppt.yifan.tv ad orders, pptstatic.yifan.tv creatives) counts as the site's own advertising or as third-party advertising served first-party.

## Artifacts

issue.body:
# 죄송합니다. Umanle S.R.L.가 AdGuard의 광고 차단을 방해하고 있습니다.

나무위키 운영사인 Umanle S.R.L.가 나무위키의 DOM 구조를 관련된 필터 업데이트가 있을 때 마다 변경하므로 필터로 차단하기에는 오차단이 발생할 수 있습니다.

또한, Umanle S.R.L.가 기술적인 안티-애드블록하여 의도적으로 나무위키 문서를 읽을 수 없게 했던 점과 전용 유저스크립트인 NamuLink의 차단 방법을 우회하게끔 네이버 파워링크 광고 알고리즘을 업데이트합니다.

## 유저스크립트 설치

[NamuLink 유저스크립트](https://github.com/List-KR/NamuLink)를 설치하여 나무위키의 파워링크 광고를 차단하실 수 있습니다.
한국어로 작성되어 있는 설치 방법은 [이 URL](https://community.list-kr.com/docs/AdGuard/Userscripts/NamuLink)를 클릭하여 확인해주세요.


## 그래도 문제가 있으신가요?
유저스크립트를 사용했을 때 발생하는 문제는 [이 이슈 트래커](https://github.com/List-KR/NamuLink/issues)로 알려주세요.
기타 문제는 [이 곳](https://github.com/List-KR/List-KR/issues)으로 알려주세요.
GitHub 이슈를 사용하시기 어렵다면, filters@adguard.com 로 문의해주세요.

<!-- adguard-filters-agent:report {"schemaVersion":1,"revisionDigest":"0cdab394eeae514c4a2f014a511fa3248c71654a0d2118d9c779b891c2f87ec5"} -->
The filter policy recommends closing without a rule

## Reproduced symptom

The reported automatic download on www⁠.opera.com/de/computer/thanks is opera.com's own first-party download flow:⁠ a hidden 1x1px iframe id="download-this" in the served HTML pointing at net.geo.opera.com/opera/stable/windows, plus the page's own "Download didn't start? Click here." fallback link. No anti-adblock wall or detector script was observed and the download fires identically with and without the ad blocker, so the repository policy gives first-party self-promotion no rule — recommend closing.

## Executor and version

Pinned prebuilt release v5.5.2.3

## Policy rationale

Repository policy (run instruction):⁠ "The site's own advertising (first-party ads):⁠ no rule; recommend closing." The reported automatic download is opera.com's own first-party download of its own product:⁠ a hidden 1x1px iframe id="download-this" in the served HTML pointing at net.geo.opera.com/opera/stable/windows (thirdParty:⁠false), with the page's own fallback link "Download didn't start? Click here." next to it. The anti-adblock premise of the label is not supported by what the page shows:⁠ no anti-adblock wall, message or content gate is present, no detector script appears in the captured requests, and the download fires identically in the unfiltered control session and in the reporter-profile session with the reporter's filters enabled. The agent never closes an issue:⁠ this is a recommendation to close, for a maintainer to check and decide.

## Artifacts

https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/actions/runs/40642425689

<sub>Automated analysis against filters at `ef8fd53`. Posted by a filters agent; a maintainer reviews before anything is merged.</sub>

Candidate rule proposed ## Reproduced symptom Reproduced — pasgoliptv44.site carries two `div.reklam-3` ad banner units (image `pasgoltvgif.webp`, alt="reklamlar") and a header announcement line, all wrapped in `` — the same advertising short link the reporter says every annotated element redirects to. The hidden elements are advertising units (class "reklam", img alt="reklamlar") and a promotional header line carrying the site's affiliate short link, not the site's own content; the repo already blocks the same `.reklam-3` class on the sibling site betanotv6.site. No existing rule in this repository covers pasgoliptv44.site (domain inventory:⁠ 0 matches), so a new domain-scoped rule is required. ## Place in the list [TurkishFilter/sections/specific.txt](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/77d1c8eb1d59cb872b0039a2296e70ac51c2755c/TurkishFilter/sections/specific.txt) At the end of the file. ## Screenshots

Используется системный видеоплеер Яндекса, который берёт видео с Rutube. И там всё время воспроизведение прерывается вставками видеорекламы. Теперь попробовал установить AdGuard для Android TV, он отлично решил проблему и заблокировал рекламу. Однако появилась новая проблема. Яндекс ТВ Станция и её плеер не запоминают серию, на которой я остановился, если включён AdGuard, приходится выбирать её вручную, а плеер помнит последнюю серию, которую я смотрел без AdGuard. comment.body:
Candidate rule proposed ## Reproduced symptom Reproduced — authgear.com's Base64 tool page carries a 409px self-promotional cross-sell card (div.tools-banner-wrapper:⁠ "Start Building", "This tool is crafted by Authgear", banner image, GitHub row) — the exact element the reporter outlined. The domain-scoped element-hiding rule authgear.com#⁠#⁠.tools-banner-wrapper was verified in the AdGuard Browser Extension baseline (visible in phase B, hidden in phase C, page integrity intact) and belongs in the Other Annoyances self-promo section. ## Rule `authgear.com##.tools-banner-wrapper` ## Executor and version Pinned prebuilt release v5.5.2.3 ## Policy rationale No close rule in the run instruction fits:⁠ the element is not a paywall, not a German anti-adblock wall, and no anti-adblock detector appears in the captured requests (get_network_log shows no detector script; only plausible.io analytics, already blocked). The instruction's first-party-ads bullet was weighed and does not bar this rule:⁠ the repository's filter policy lists "Block self-promotion of websites (any type of advertising promoting goods or services owned by the site owner, without receiving commercial compensation from a third party), if it is considered an annoying element" as a purpose of the AdGuard Other Annoyances filter, which maintains a dedicated self-promo section, and the AdGuard Widgets filter explicitly excludes self-promotion, so this self-promotional card is the repo's documented self-promo annoyance category rather than first-party ad inventory. Flagged for the maintainer to confirm against the run instruction. ## Place in the list [AnnoyancesFilter/Other/sections/self-promo.txt](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/c334135c54ddbe2f1ffe61b24da72fbc4410c797/AnnoyancesFilter/Other/sections/self-promo.txt) At the end of the file. ## Screenshots
Without and with the rule | Without the rule | With the rule | |---|---| | | |

issue.body:
### Prerequisites - [x] This site DOES NOT contain sexually explicit material, otherwise use [NSFW-specific form](./new?template=bug_report_NSFW.yml); - [x] Filters were updated before reproducing an issue; - [x] AdGuard product version is up-to-date; - [x] Browser version is up-to-date; - [x] If the site or app is broken, disabling AdGuard protection resolves an issue. ### What product do you use? Other ad blocker ### AdGuard version uBlock Origin 1.75.0 ### What type of problem have you encountered? Website or app doesn't work properly ### Which browser(s) do you use? other (specify in comment below) ### Which device do you use? Desktop ### Where is the problem encountered? https://onepage.io/ ### Ad Blocking AdGuard Base filter, EasyList ### Privacy EasyPrivacy, AdGuard URL Tracking filter ### Social Widgets _No response_ ### Annoyances EasyList Cookie List, AdGuard Cookie Notices filter ### Security _No response_ ### Other _No response_ ### DNS filters _No response_ ### Language-specific _No response_ ### What Stealth Mode options do you have enabled? _No response_ ### Add your comment and screenshots **Problem** onepage.io renders a blank white page when **AdGuard Cookie Notices** is enabled. The same happens on every site built with the Onepage website builder, which serves its assets from `onecdn.io`. **Cause** The generic rule `/cookie-banner$domain=~github.com|~…` blocks the builder's lazily-loaded chunks: - `https://onecdn.io/b/client//css/cookie-banner.css` - `https://onecdn.io/b/client//js/cookie-banner.bundle.js` The app throws `Uncaught Error: Loading CSS chunk 54 failed`, and React unmounts the entire page. **Prior reports** This has been fixed per domain several times (#220837, #224690, #226324): `@@||onecdn.io/b/client/*/cookie-banner.$domain=paulpadel.com` `@@||onecdn.io/b/client/*/cookie-banner.$domain=myoreflextherapie-heidelberg.de|krmr.it|cleverfit.fitness-konzepte.de|soldaten-kompass.de` Every new Onepage site breaks until someone reports it. Currently affected and not exempted, for example: - https://onepage.io/ (the builder's own site) - https://founderblocks.io/ **Suggested fix** `onecdn.io` is Onepage's own CDN, so a single generic exception would fix all current and future Onepage sites: `@@||onecdn.io/b/client/*/cookie-banner.` The cookie banner itself can still be hidden cosmetically, as you already do with `##.con-kit-component-cookie-banner` on several of these domains. Screenshots

Currently affected and not exempted, for example: - https://onepage.io/ (the builder's own site) - https://founderblocks.io/ **Suggested fix** `onecdn.io` is Onepage's own CDN, so a single generic exception would fix all current and future Onepage sites: `@@||onecdn.io/b/client/*/cookie-banner.` The cookie banner itself can still be hidden cosmetically, as you already do with `##.con-kit-component-cookie-banner` on several of these domains. ### Prerequisites - [x] This site DOES NOT contain sexually explicit material, otherwise use [NSFW-specific form](./new?template=bug_report_NSFW.yml); - [x] Filters were updated before reproducing an issue; - [x] AdGuard product version is up-to-date; - [x] Browser version is up-to-date; - [x] If the site or app is broken, disabling AdGuard protection resolves an issue. ### What product do you use? Other ad blocker ### AdGuard version uBlock Origin 1.75.0 ### What type of problem have you encountered? Website or app doesn't work properly ### Which browser(s) do you use? other (specify in comment below) ### Which device do you use? Desktop ### Where is the problem encountered? https://onepage.io/ ### Ad Blocking AdGuard Base filter, EasyList ### Privacy EasyPrivacy, AdGuard URL Tracking filter ### Social Widgets _No response_ ### Annoyances EasyList Cookie List, AdGuard Cookie Notices filter ### Security _No response_ ### Other _No response_ ### DNS filters _No response_ ### Language-specific _No response_ ### What Stealth Mode options do you have enabled? _No response_ ### Add your comment and screenshots **Problem** onepage.io renders a blank white page when **AdGuard Cookie Notices** is enabled. The same happens on every site built with the Onepage website builder, which serves its assets from `onecdn.io`. **Cause** The generic rule `/cookie-banner$domain=~github.com|~…` blocks the builder's lazily-loaded chunks: - `https://onecdn.io/b/client//css/cookie-banner.css` - `https://onecdn.io/b/client//js/cookie-banner.bundle.js` The app throws `Uncaught Error: Loading CSS chunk 54 failed`, and React unmounts the entire page. **Prior reports** This has been fixed per domain several times (#220837, #224690, #226324): `@@||onecdn.io/b/client/*/cookie-banner.$domain=paulpadel.com` `@@||onecdn.io/b/client/*/cookie-banner.$domain=myoreflextherapie-heidelberg.de|krmr.it|cleverfit.fitness-konzepte.de|soldaten-kompass.de` Every new Onepage site breaks until someone reports it. Currently affected and not exempted, for example: - https://onepage.io/ (the builder's own site) - https://founderblocks.io/ **Suggested fix** `onecdn.io` is Onepage's own CDN, so a single generic exception would fix all current and future Onepage sites: `@@||onecdn.io/b/client/*/cookie-banner.` The cookie banner itself can still be hidden cosmetically, as you already do with `##.con-kit-component-cookie-banner` on several of these domains. The filter policy recommends closing without a rule

## Reproduced symptom

The reporter-annotated gambling banner grid on doujin.desu.xxx is the site's own first-party advertising:⁠ the slots are filled from the site's /api/banners endpoint and the creatives are served from its own CDN pic.desu.xxx, so the filter policy's "first-party ads:⁠ no rule" rule applies and the report should be closed. The only third-party ad/tracking requests on the page are already blocked by existing Base/Tracking filter rules.

## Executor and version

Pinned prebuilt release v5.5.2.3

## Policy rationale

Run instruction filter policy:⁠ "The site's own advertising (first-party ads):⁠ no rule; recommend closing." Observed:⁠ banner data comes from the first-party XHR https:⁠//doujin.desu.xxx/api/banners and every creative image is served from the first-party host pic.desu.xxx/content/banner/* (thirdParty:⁠false), rendered by the site's own div.partner-slot-frame component with no third-party ad-network script or iframe involved. Filter policy document:⁠ "The site's own advertising should not be deliberately blocked." The only third-party ad/tracking requests on the page (ab.spoolermoy.com, uq.giggedanopsia.com, s10.histats.com) are already blocked by existing AdGuard Base/Tracking filter rules, so no further rule is needed.

<!-- adguard-filters-agent:report {"schemaVersion":1,"revisionDigest":"88cd32cb3ed4895436839171bb5c904f5a2824609e0d2a41ff41346f3c567fbc"} -->
Analysis-only findings, no verified change

## Reproduced symptom

Indeterminate — www⁠.mackeyfi605.sbs serves an inline popunder:⁠ a transparent full-viewport #⁠sys-auth-layer swallows clicks on the player and calls window.open to https:⁠//z.cdn.traffmovie.com/load?o=c&⁠z=2064894741..., the URL in the reporter's screenshot. Two rehearsals in the CLI-filtered browser reproduced the pop-up (one page opened to z.cdn.traffmovie.com), while the existing ||cdn.traffmovie.com^ rule only blocks the destination request. The scriptlet candidate was applied by the engine but apply_rule could not click the trigger, because the overlay is display:⁠none for 120 s after load and reveal-step waits cap at 5 s per step.

## Candidate for review

`mackeyfi605.sbs#%#//scriptlet('prevent-window-open')`

TurkishFilter/sections/general_extensions.txt

Not verified: environment limit on the behavioural rehearsal:⁠ #⁠sys-auth-layer is display:⁠none (zero-size rect) for the first 120 s after DOMContentLoaded (inline FIRST_DELAY=2*60*1000), while apply_rule allows at most 5 s per wait step and 12 steps (\~60 s), so the reveal click was refused with target_unavailable in phases A, B and C (popupsOpened 0 in all three). visualReview was therefore inconclusive (symptom unclear, a pop-up tab cannot be seen in before/after screenshots), with pageIntegrity intact, adLayoutResidue absent, observedDamage empty, remainingInstances empty and failedCandidateChecks empty; the candidate itself was reported applied in the candidate phase. Outside the experiment, two interact_page rehearsals in the CLI-filtered browser clicked the same overlay once it activated and each reported popupsOpened:⁠1 with popupHosts:⁠[⁠"z.cdn.traffmovie.com"]⁠, matching the URL in the reporter's screenshot.

## Missing information

- No served guidance for prevent-window-open syntax/parameters or for section files inside a regional filter: lookup_rule_guidance(topic=scriptlet) returned only the Safari/script-rule section, the $popup modifier limitations and debugging scriptlets; it did not document the `prevent-window-open` scriptlet's argument semantics (whether a plain-string first argument is a URL substring, and what the `replacement` argument does), so the decision to use the parameterless form rested on repository examples (BaseFilter/sections/general_extensions.txt) rather than on the served documents. Likewise, the placement topic names the Turkish filter folder (TurkishFilter/sections) but not which section file inside it holds site-specific scriptlet rules; I had to infer TurkishFilter/sections/general_extensions.txt from a domain search hit on a shared `set-constant` scriptlet rule.

Analysis-only findings, no verified change

## Reproduced symptom

Indeterminate — The reported tvtoday.de "leftovers" are three empty 350px-tall ad containers (.banner-wrapper, ad slot already blocked by the general /adengine.js rule) that leave blank gaps between mobile schedule rows; the fix is a domain-scoped element-hiding rule in GermanFilter/sections/specific.txt. Validation could not be completed — the one judged run resolved the symptom but was refused for an unstyled-navigation artifact present in both phases, and the narrower :⁠has() form hit HTTP 403 phase failures — so the rule goes to a maintainer for review.

## Candidate for review

`tvtoday.de##.banner-wrapper:has(> [data-slot="ad-slot"])`

GermanFilter/sections/specific.txt

Not verified: Not judged:⁠ the last run failed at phase C - "Phase C navigation failed (http_blocked):⁠ main document returned HTTP 403" - after phase A had returned HTTP 403 on the two earlier attempts; the host directed no further retry. The equivalent plain form tvtoday.de#⁠#⁠.banner-wrapper was judged once and the vision review reported the symptom resolved with no ad layout residue and no remaining instances, but rejected it as pageIntegrity regressed for an unstyled bullet-list top navigation and run-together breadcrumbs; that unstyled rendering is present in the before phase too (phase B document 408x19949 vs the styled 375x5466 page in phase A and in the live filtered session, which logged four HTTP 500 resource failures), so the damage is a page-load artifact rather than the rule's effect, yet the experiment refused the candidate.

### Issue URL (Social Widget) [https://www.instagram.com/](https://adguardteam.github.io/AnonymousRedirect/redirect.html?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.instagram.com%2F) ### Comment > When AdGuard is active some posts have UI elements removed that should not be. ### Issue URL (Social Widget) [https://www.instagram.com/](https://adguardteam.github.io/AnonymousRedirect/redirect.html?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.instagram.com%2F) ### Comment > When AdGuard is active some posts have UI elements removed that should not be. I included images with AdGuard paused showing an ad and the correct UI display. The other image is with AdGuard active where the ads are gone, but so are some UI elements that should not be removed. > I do not have the social like button filter active. They show for some posts, but are missing for other posts. > Additional information not in these images is that when I want to block a user, the pop-up to block them can have it's UI altered so that it becomes unusable. comment.body:
Candidate rule proposed ## Reproduced symptom Reproduced — The Italian article page ran a first-party inline ad-blocker detector that opened a full-screen "Disabilita il blocco degli annunci pubblicitari" modal with a fixed dark backdrop and scroll lock; the scriptlet prevent-setTimeout('detectAdBlock') stopped the detector, so the modal never appeared and the article became fully readable in the verified before/after experiment. ## Rule `ilgiornaledellarte.com#%#//scriptlet('prevent-setTimeout', 'detectAdBlock')` ## Policy rationale Run instruction, anti-adblock policy:⁠ for any non-German anti-adblock wall a rule may be written once the page's captured requests show the detector script — the detector is inline in the captured first-party document and its adsbygoogle probe request is in the captured inventory. Policy case for blocking applies:⁠ the wall aggressively insists on disabling the ad blocker and effectively prevents using the website (full-screen modal, fixed backdrop, scrolling locked, close control withheld 30 s). Not excluded:⁠ the site's own advertising, paywalls and the German-wall exclusion do not apply (Italian page), and the report is an anti-adblock wall, not a scam/phishing page. Maintainer rule followed:⁠ a scriptlet neutralizes the detector because a cosmetic hide of the popup is not enough (separate fixed backdrop plus body scroll lock). ## Place in the list [AnnoyancesFilter/Popups/sections/antiadblock.txt](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/4493b90f4f1927ed1a79a521f42064579bab1716/AnnoyancesFilter/Popups/sections/antiadblock.txt) At the end of the file. ## Missing information - Reporter settings import cannot be replayed in the adguard_cli environment: Issue #⁠245638 carries a reporter settings import URL (reports.adguard.com/settings/import.html?product_type=and...), which the run instruction designates as the `reported_on_current` profile. In the locked adguard_cli environment, launch_browser refuses `settings` for the only available session shape ("A control session (extension \⁠"none\⁠") runs no blocker and takes no \⁠"settings\⁠""), so neither `reported_on_current` nor the `defaults_plus_required` controlled comparison the instruction asks for could be launched. ### Issue URL (Incorrect Blocking) [https://www.teamtavern.net/games/deadlock](https://adguardteam.github.io/AnonymousRedirect/redirect.html?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.teamtavern.net%2Fgames%2Fdeadlock) ### Comment > **Title:** Allowlisted site still gets filtering; element hiding of `google_ads_iframe` frames leaves Google's vignette blocking all clicks > > **Environment** > - AdGuard AdBlocker 5.5.3.6 (Chrome extension) > - Chrome 141, Windows 11, desktop > - Filters: AdGuard Base filter, AdGuard German filter (plus defaults) > - Site: https://www.teamtavern.net, which I run. It's allowlisted: the popup says "Protection is disabled" for teamtavern.net. > > **Summary** > > With teamtavern.net allowlisted, AdGuard still filters on its pages. Sometimes this includes hiding Google's ad frames with cosmetic rules. When it hides the frame of a Google Ad Manager interstitial (the "vignette"), the vignette's outer container stays on screen as a transparent, full-window layer at the top z-index. Every click lands on it, and the page is unusable until reloaded. > > **Steps to reproduce** (intermittent) > 1. Allowlist www.teamtavern.net. > 2. Open the site and follow a couple of internal links, or switch away from the tab and back. Either can trigger Google's interstitial. > 3. On some page loads the interstitial never appears. Instead, nothing on the page responds to clicks, and the URL ends in `#google_vignette`. > > **Expected:** with the site allowlisted, no filtering or element hiding on its pages, so the interstitial shows normally with its Close button. > > **Actual:** I caught it twice in DevTools on the frozen page: > - Top of the click stack: `ins#gpt_unit_/21726375739,22767752827/teamtavern.net_1127/interstitial_6936_0`, `position: fixed`, 100vw × 100vh, `z-index: 2147483647`, `pointer-events: auto`, transparent background. > - Inside it, `div#google_ads_iframe_…__container__` and the ad iframe `iframe#google_ads_iframe_…` both have inline `display: inline !important`, yet compute to `display: none`. > - DevTools → Computed → display lists the winning declarations as: > ``` > none !important [name^="google_ads_iframe"] user agent stylesheet > none !important [id^="google_ads_iframe_"] user agent stylesheet > ``` > Chrome's own UA stylesheet has no such rules. These are extension-injected, user-origin element-hiding rules. > - The ad inside the iframe had loaded fully, with its card, creative and dismiss button. Only the iframe was hidden. > - Setting `pointer-events: none` on the `ins` from the console made the page usable again. > > AdGuard is the only content blocker enabled in this profile. The other enabled extensions are Bitwarden, Google Translate, Kagi Search, Open Multiple URLs, Playwright and an image viewer of my own, and none of them injects element-hiding CSS. > > **Filtering log on the allowlisted site** > > On a later visit, I kept the filtering log open. It showed AdGuard still blocking requests on a teamtavern.net tab, all from third-party ad frames: > > | Source frame | Example rule (filter) | > | --- | --- | > | `googleads.g.doubleclick.net` | `\|\|google.com/pagead/drt/` (Base), `/googleads.$domain=g.doubleclick…` (German) | > | `elb.the-ozone-project.com`, `rtb.gumgum.com`, `onetag-sys.com` | `\|\|rubiconproject.com^`, `\|\|adform.net^`, `\|\|g.doubleclick.net^` and others (Base) | > > The interstitial displayed correctly on that visit. I haven't yet captured the log during a freeze, so I can't show the element-hiding rule in the log itself. > > **Questions** > 1. Should the allowlist for a site also cover requests and element hiding inside third-party frames on its pages? The log shows it doesn't. > 2. Under what conditions do cosmetic rules still apply on an allowlisted site? It happens on some page loads and not others. > 3. For the filter maintainers: hiding `[id^="google_ads_iframe_"]` when Google's interstitial has loaded leaves its `ins#gpt_unit_…interstitial…` container covering the page and swallowing every click. Users without any allowlist can hit the same lock-up when the network rules let the interstitial load. A matching rule for the interstitial container, or excluding interstitial frames from the hiding rule, would avoid it. ``` Username: @bklaric ``` ### Screenshots

Analysis-only findings, no verified change

## Reproduced symptom

Indeterminate — The reported delta.dev cookie banner is served by the site's c15t consent manager, but this environment's egress resolves the CMP policy "world_no_banner", so the banner never renders here and the candidate rule could not be verified (apply_rule also refused with baseline_manifest_invalid). The candidate hides only the banner variant of that consent component while leaving the footer privacy-settings dialog usable, and is carried for human review.

## Candidate for review

`delta.dev##[aria-label="Cookie preferences"]:has(button[aria-label="Customize cookie settings"])`

AnnoyancesFilter/Cookies/sections/cookies_specific.txt

Not verified: The reported banner is region-gated:⁠ the site's c15t backend (zed-us-east-1-zed-production.c15t.dev/init, artifact:⁠har:⁠340d68c9-860b-4a5e-b41a-55b510cb2e51) returned policyDecision "world_no_banner" (ui.mode none, jurisdiction NONE, country US/IA) for this session's egress, so the banner variant is never rendered on the baseline page and the banner-scoped selector matched nothing (no proxy route is available to reach an opt-in region). Only the dialog variant of the same component could be rendered live, via the footer "Cookies" control, and it lacks the banner-only "Customize cookie settings" control. apply_rule additionally refused to run at all:⁠ environment_capability_limited / baseline_manifest_invalid ("A requested official filter could not be added from the native catalog", retryable false), and no lint_rule tool was offered, so no before/after phase experiment or vision verdict exists.

The same baseline listed skippedSources for the reporter's custom uBlock filters (uBlock filters – Other Annoyances, uBlock filters, My filter) as unresolved_name. comment.body:
Hi, I'm the wBlock dev. I told timlt this was Adtoniq, but the popup in the screenshot is Admiral, so that's why the adtoniq rule did nothing. Sorry for the detour.

The Admiral rules in the Popups filter that include thegatewaypundit.com are commented out. And the page also loads `<script src="//ruamupr.com/13529" onload="dlu()" onerror="dlu()">`, where `dlu()` falls back to first-party bait files. uBO handles this with `||ruamupr.com^$script,redirect=noopjs,domain=thegatewaypundit.com` in its Unbreak list and `thegatewaypundit.com##.hide-for-admiral`.

The popup only shows every day or two, which is probably why you couldn't reproduce it. Could you take another look with that in mind?

Реклама не повторяется.

Пожалуйста, попробуйте выполнить следующие действия, а затем снова проверьте проблему:

1. Включите русский фильтр
2. Отключите все блокировщики контента в настройках Safari и снова включите их
3. Перезапустите Safari
4. Перезапустите AdGuard
5. Проверьте наличие обновлений фильтров в AdGuard.

### Важно:
* Не закрывайте окно AdGuard примерно 60 секунд, потому что iOS может прервать процесс настройки.

Please block Ad-Shield advertisement by installing [tinyShield userscript](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield).

Analysis-only findings, no verified change

Fallback — The page host was unreachable:⁠ Target unreachable from this runner:⁠ https:⁠//thehalara.de/ (ERR_PROXY_CONNECTION_FAILED in 3/3 browser profiles).

## Reproduced symptom

Indeterminate — thehalara.de shows a full-screen lucky-wheel giveaway popup (email capture plus "SPIELEN" wheel) covering the shop; the rule halara.*,thehalara.*#⁠#⁠#⁠LuckyWheelGiveawayWrap was verified by the CLI-proxy A/B/C experiment (symptom resolved, page intact), but the run's separate full-page vision requirement could not be completed before browser access to the site was exhausted, so the verified rule goes to human review.

## Candidate for review

`halara.*,thehalara.*###LuckyWheelGiveawayWrap`

AnnoyancesFilter/Popups/sections/subscriptions_specific.txt

Not verified: Not unverified by the rule experiment:⁠ apply_rule returned environmentExperiment "verified" with visualReview verdict "verified", symptom "resolved", adLayoutResidue "absent", pageIntegrity "intact", no remaining instances and no observed damage. The run's terminal gate additionally required a complete full-page vision capture from the proxied session, and that could not be produced:⁠ the page's lower region returned blank (unloaded) tiles that batch vision refused as unreadable, a reload left the page in a "No internet" state, and the next navigation failed with ERR_PROXY_CONNECTION_FAILED after the 3/3 browser-access budget for the target was exhausted, with the host instructing finish_fix analysis_only. Alternative placement if the maintainers prefer the general popup section:⁠ AnnoyancesFilter/Popups/sections/popups_specific.txt.

## Missing information

- Reporter settings import URL cannot be applied in the adguard_cli (proxy) route: Issue #⁠245655 carries a reports.adguard.com settings import URL, and the run instruction says the reporter profile is `reported_on_current` and that only a session launched with it may verify a rule. In the locked adguard_cli environment the run instruction requires launching every evidence session with extension:⁠"none", and launch_browser refuses `settings` for a control session ("A control session (extension \⁠"none\⁠") runs no blocker and takes no \⁠"settings\⁠""). So the reporter's exact filter selection and Stealth state could not be reproduced; validation ran on the issue-derived agent_selected profile (mobile viewport, de-DE, Europe/Berlin) and the CLI proxy's own baseline. Also missing:⁠ no lint command/tool is offered in this run, so the candidate was not linted by the repository's linter.

comment.body:
Candidate rule proposed ## Reproduced symptom Reproduced — Reproduced the reporter's red-outlined cookie-consent dialog (#⁠cookie-banner, fixed across the bottom of the business.amazon.de homepage) in the locked AdGuard CLI baseline, where no element-hiding rule acted on it, and verified that the domain-scoped `business.amazon.de###cookie-banner` rule hides it with the page intact and nothing left over. ## Rule `business.amazon.de###cookie-banner` ## Policy rationale The report is a cookie-notice annoyance on a first-party page dialog; it is not the site's own advertising, so the first-party-advertising rule does not apply. It is not a paywall and not an anti-adblock/blocker-detection wall (the page shows a consent dialog, not a detector or a 'disable your ad blocker' message), so neither anti-adblock rule applies and no detector-script evidence is needed. It is not a scam/phishing/malware page; it is an ordinary website-filtering annoyance open to rule generation. ## Place in the list [AnnoyancesFilter/Cookies/sections/cookies_specific.txt](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/5a6d91fc5b22514899a92614554d9813fc3a0241/AnnoyancesFilter/Cookies/sections/cookies_specific.txt) By adding the domain to the existing rule on [line 13259](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/5a6d91fc5b22514899a92614554d9813fc3a0241/AnnoyancesFilter/Cookies/sections/cookies_specific.txt#L13259). ## Missing information - CLI baseline does not expose which filter lists it loaded, so generic-rule coverage cannot be proven: `get_applied_rules` in the locked adguard_cli session only names lists that produced events (ids 2 Base, 3 Tracking, 19 Popups) and only rules that acted; generic element-hiding rules (no domain prefix) never appear in the phase-B `appliedRules` inventory (212 rules, all domain-matched), and no tool reports the prepared baseline's loaded filter ids. I therefore could not determine whether the repo's generic `###cookie-banner` rule (AnnoyancesFilter/Cookies/sections/cookies_general.txt:⁠521) is present in the baseline but inactive, or absent from it. Live evidence only shows the banner visible in phase B and hidden in phase C, so the domain-scoped rule is proposed on that evidence; a way to list the baseline's enabled filter ids/rule counts would settle whether the generic rule already covers this site. ## Screenshots
Without and with the rule | Without the rule | With the rule | |---|---| | | |
## Artifacts https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/actions/runs/40723781976 Automated analysis against filters at `5a6d91f`. Posted by a filters agent; a maintainer reviews before anything is merged.

comment.body:
Candidate rule proposed ## Reproduced symptom Reproduced — foxnews.com shows a full-viewport Admiral ("Powered By getadmiral.com") anti-adblock modal that also sets overflow:⁠hidden on html/body, so the page cannot be scrolled; its loader scripts come from the third-party host heyhotshots.com. Blocking ||heyhotshots.com^$domain=foxnews.com removed the wall with page integrity intact in a verified before/after experiment, so I propose adding that rule to the AnnoyancesFilter anti-adblock section. ## Rule `||heyhotshots.com^$domain=foxnews.com` ## Policy rationale Run instruction, filter policy:⁠ this is not a German site's wall and not first-party advertising or a paywall; the captured page requests show the anti-adblock detector/modal scripts (heyhotshots.com ModalEngage, ne6dlyk96..., pnod56.js), which is the stated precondition for writing a rule for a non-German anti-adblock wall. Run instruction, maintainer rules:⁠ the wall is not fixable by hiding the popup alone because the vendor script locks scrolling with inline overflow:⁠hidden on html/body, so the detector/loader is stopped instead; the fix fits no existing shared or project-grouped rule (no Admiral/heyhotshots rule exists in the repository), so a new site-scoped rule is written. Run instruction, placement:⁠ the file was chosen from where the repository already keeps rules like this one - AnnoyancesFilter/Popups/sections/antiadblock.txt holds foxnews.com's other anti-adblock rules. ## Place in the list [AnnoyancesFilter/Popups/sections/antiadblock.txt](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/1d8d545b7b510314e8ed6f02b0a490cc76d42fc9/AnnoyancesFilter/Popups/sections/antiadblock.txt) At the end of the file. ## Screenshots

issue.title: speedof.me: AdGuard Base rules hide mobile START TEST and results
issue.body: ### Prerequisites - [x] This site DOES NOT contain sexually explicit material, otherwise use [NSFW-specific form](./new?template=bug_report_NSFW.yml); - [x] Filters were updated before reproducing an issue; - [x] AdGuard product version is up-to-date; - [x] Browser version is up-to-date; - [x] If the site or app is broken, disabling AdGuard protection resolves an issue. ### What product do you use? AdGuard Browser Extension ### AdGuard version 5.5.3.3 (MV3 browser extension) ### What type of problem have you encountered? Website or app doesn't work properly ### Which browser(s) do you use? Chrome ### Which device do you use? Desktop ### Where is the problem encountered? https://speedof.me/m/ ### Ad Blocking AdGuard Base filter ### Privacy _No response_ ### Social Widgets _No response_ ### Annoyances AdGuard Cookie Notices filter, AdGuard Popups filter, AdGuard Other Annoyances filter ### Security _No response_ ### Other _No response_ ### DNS filters _No response_ ### Language-specific _No response_ ### What Stealth Mode options do you have enabled? _No response_ ### Add your comment and screenshots Hi, the recent filter changes associated with #245320 break the mobile speed test on SpeedOf.Me: https://speedof.me/m/ (build 3.205.2509). The START TEST control disappears, so visitors cannot start a speed test. With AdGuard disabled, the control is visible again. ### Rules responsible This rule hides the mobile START TEST control and the introductory text: ```text speedof.me###intro_container > div:not(.intro-group-container, .intro-dots) ``` This rule also matches the entire mobile results panel because `#result_container` is missing from its exceptions: ```text speedof.me##.middle-container > div:not(#progress_container, #share_container, #history_container, #intro_container) ``` ### Reproduction 1. Open https://speedof.me/m/ at a mobile viewport (390 × 844 in this reproduction). 2. Enable AdGuard with the filters listed above and the current published speedof.me rules. 3. Reload: the START TEST control and introductory text are missing. 4. Disable AdGuard and reload: START TEST and the introductory text return. Captured on October 28, 2026 using Chromium 143.0.7499.169 with AdGuard Browser Extension MV3 v5.5.3.3 at a mobile viewport. These are desktop Chrome captures of the mobile site, not captures from an Android or iOS device. Enabled filters: AdGuard Base 2.4.93.84, Cookie Notices 2.0.95.55, Popups 2.0.84.8, and Other Annoyances 2.0.48.76. The current published speedof.me rules from AdguardFilters revision `5a6d91f` were also loaded as user rules because bundled lists can lag the repository. No additional experimental blocking rules were used. Also reproduced with Chrome for Testing 156.0.8078.73 on macOS ARM64 at 390 × 844 using the same published rules. With only the intro-container rule exempted, START TEST returned and a real test completed, but the results panel and Repeat control remained hidden. Please revise the rules to preserve the START TEST control and mobile results panel. ### House promotions Separately, some placements promote SpeedOf.Me's own API, MCP integration, and connection certificate. These are promotions for the site's own services without third-party compensation. Could you review their treatment under the Base-filter policy concerning a site's own advertising? https://adguard.com/kb/general/ad-filtering/filter-policy/#limitations-and-exceptions Compensated affiliate offers have a different classification. ### Screenshots AdGuard enabled: START TEST and the introductory content are missing. AdGuard disabled: START TEST and the introductory content are visible. ### Privacy - [x] I agree to follow this condition

Analysis-only findings, no verified change

## Reproduced symptom

Indeterminate — The wielerflits.nl article loads and its Refinery89 and lower ad placements exist but stay empty, so the reporter's filled Allianz/Eurovlamers creatives were never observed being suppressed and the prepared-baseline symptom reading is missing. The one uncovered ad-recovery host (oofadvanced.com) was tested and the vendor rotated to content-loader.com, so no single validated rule exists; this is reported for human review.

## Candidate for review

`||oofadvanced.com^$domain=wielerflits.nl`

BaseFilter/sections/specific.txt

Not verified: apply_rule's visual review was inconclusive:⁠ symptom unclear, pageIntegrity unclear, adLayoutResidue present, remainingInstances empty, observedDamage empty, failedCandidateChecks empty; its only stated obstruction was a cookie-consent dialog over the article body in the after phase, and the prepared-baseline structured symptom reading is missing. The experiment's own network verification also undercuts the rule:⁠ phase B carried 54 oofadvanced.com requests and phase C blocked the host, but the verdict was new_third_party_hosts because 0-9.stg.content-loader.com and stg.content-loader.com took over, so the vendor rotates delivery domains instead of stopping. Treat as a lead on the rotating ad-recovery channel, not as a validated fix.

Analysis-only findings, no verified change

## Reproduced symptom

Indeterminate — zseek.ru's right sidebar shows a 300×500 lavender ad banner served through the site's own `/stargate?id=` click-through gateway, and the equivalent of the existing hlamer.ru rule for that gateway removed it with page integrity intact. The exact scoped rule the host requires could not be re-verified because the vision inventory then counted unrelated ATOTO page-skin side-rail ads — already present in the unfiltered baseline — as remaining instances, so the rule is handed over for review.

## Candidate for review

`zseek.ru##a[href^="/stargate?id="]`

CyrillicFilters/RussianFilter/sections/specific.txt

Not verified: The scoped run (validation-dd30a0e13120) confirmed the reporter's lavender /stargate banner gone, pageIntegrity intact and no damage, but the review rejected it for remainingInstances:⁠ two ATOTO page-skin side-rail ads at the page edges. Those rails are a different, pre-existing ad family — my own vision read of the unfiltered phase-B tile (20f98771) shows them present before any rule, the reporter marked only the sidebar banner, and the plain session holds no ATOTO or fixed-rail element. The same selector in multi-domain form was fully verified in validation-9e8a6262454c (symptom resolved, adLayoutResidue absent, remainingInstances empty, integrity intact; domChecks:⁠ gap 524-⁠>34 px, nothing over 150 px above #⁠block-filter). No further attempt may re-run an equivalent rule, so this scoped rule is handed over unverified.

## Still visible after the rule

- Left edge of the page, full-height skin banner beside the "Обновление сериалов" content column (Rick and Morty artwork with the caption "Смотрите свои любимые сериалы вместе с АТОТО") — Large promotional advertising banner occupying the entire left margin of the homepage with partner marketing copy and artwork; an advertising block of the same symptom class the reporter complained about, still rendered on the page.
- Right edge of the page, full-height skin banner beside the right sidebar/"Подборки" column (Attack on Titan artwork with the caption "Продолжи просмотр своего любимого аниме на АТОТО") — Large promotional advertising banner occupying the entire right margin of the homepage with partner marketing copy and artwork; a further advertising block matching the reporter-defined advertising symptom, still rendered on the page.

issue.body: ### Prerequisites - [x] This site DOES NOT contain sexually explicit material, otherwise use [NSFW-specific form](./new?template=bug_report_NSFW.yml); - [x] Filters were updated before reproducing an issue; - [x] AdGuard product version is up-to-date; - [x] Browser version is up-to-date; - [x] If the site or app is broken, disabling AdGuard protection resolves an issue. ### What product do you use? AdGuard Browser Extension ### AdGuard version 5.5.3.3 (MV3 browser extension) ### What type of problem have you encountered? Website or app doesn't work properly ### Which browser(s) do you use? Chrome ### Which device do you use? Desktop ### Where is the problem encountered? https://speedof.me/m/ ### Ad Blocking AdGuard Base filter ### Privacy _No response_ ### Social Widgets _No response_ ### Annoyances AdGuard Cookie Notices filter, AdGuard Popups filter, AdGuard Other Annoyances filter ### Security _No response_ ### Other _No response_ ### DNS filters _No response_ ### Language-specific _No response_ ### What Stealth Mode options do you have enabled? _No response_ ### Add your comment and screenshots Hi, the recent filter changes associated with #245320 break the mobile speed test on SpeedOf.Me: https://speedof.me/m/ (build 3.205.2509). The START TEST control disappears, so visitors cannot start a speed test. With AdGuard disabled, the control is visible again. ### Rules responsible This rule hides the mobile START TEST control and the introductory text: ```text speedof.me###intro_container > div:not(.intro-group-container, .intro-dots) ``` This rule also matches the entire mobile results panel because `#result_container` is missing from its exceptions: ```text speedof.me##.middle-container > div:not(#progress_container, #share_container, #history_container, #intro_container) ``` ### Reproduction 1. Open https://speedof.me/m/ at a mobile viewport (390 × 844 in this reproduction). 2. Enable AdGuard with the filters listed above and the current published speedof.me rules. 3. Reload: the START TEST control and introductory text are missing. 4. Disable AdGuard and reload: START TEST and the introductory text return. Captured on October 28, 2026 using Chromium 143.0.7499.169 with AdGuard Browser Extension MV3 v5.5.3.3 at a mobile viewport. These are desktop Chrome captures of the mobile site, not captures from an Android or iOS device. Enabled filters: AdGuard Base 2.4.93.84, Cookie Notices 2.0.95.55, Popups 2.0.84.8, and Other Annoyances 2.0.48.76. The current published speedof.me rules from AdguardFilters revision `5a6d91f` were also loaded as user rules because bundled lists can lag the repository. No additional experimental blocking rules were used. Also reproduced with Chrome for Testing 156.0.8078.73 on macOS ARM64 at 390 × 844 using the same published rules. With only the intro-container rule exempted, START TEST returned and a real test completed, but the results panel and Repeat control remained hidden. Please revise the rules to preserve the START TEST control and mobile results panel. ### House promotions Separately, some placements promote SpeedOf.Me's own API, MCP integration, and connection certificate. These are promotions for the site's own services without third-party compensation. Could you review their treatment under the Base-filter policy concerning a site's own advertising? https://adguard.com/kb/general/ad-filtering/filter-policy/#limitations-and-exceptions Compensated affiliate offers have a different classification. ### Screenshots AdGuard enabled: START TEST and the introductory content are missing. AdGuard disabled: START TEST and the introductory content are visible. ### Privacy - [x] I agree to follow this condition

Analysis-only findings, no verified change

## Reproduced symptom

Indeterminate — The checkout's Ad-Shield rule `speedof.me###intro_container > div:not(.intro-group-container, .intro-dots)` (BaseFilter/sections/specific.txt:⁠1906) matches the three visible intro children on the live mobile page, but the pinned extension's bundled lists predate it, so the filtered baseline is not broken and apply_rule returned baseline_symptom_absent; a site-pinned `#@#` exception is carried unverified.

## Candidate for review

`speedof.me#@##intro_container > div:not(.intro-group-container, .intro-dots)`

BaseFilter/sections/specific.txt

Not verified: apply_rule returned environmentExperiment=inconclusive with errorKind=baseline_symptom_absent (validationSkipped, phases A/B only):⁠ the prepared AdGuard Browser Extension v5.5.2.3 session loads bundled filter lists that predate this repository revision, so the culprit rule BaseFilter/sections/specific.txt:⁠1906 was never applied (get_applied_rules:⁠ 8 rules, none of them this one; its scriptlet neighbour is applied with a different argument than line 1899), and the filtered baseline already shows #⁠intro_container ⁠> div.instruction, div.start-test-btn and div.description as display:⁠block. With no breakage in phase B there was nothing to restore in phase C, so the exception could not be verified. Evidence that the rule does hide the START TEST control is the reporter's paired screenshots and the live match of the rule's exact selector against those three content children; no ad element currently sits inside #⁠intro_container.

## Executor and version

Pinned prebuilt release v5.5.2.3

## Missing information

- No way to validate a rule against the repository's current filter lists when the prepared extension bundle lags them: This report blames rules that exist in the checkout (BaseFilter/sections/specific.txt lines 1904, 1906, 1908) but are absent from the filter lists the prepared AdGuard Browser Extension v5.5.2.3 session actually loads:⁠ get_applied_rules reported 8 applied rules (omittedRuleCount 0) and none of them is the speedof.me Ad-Shield hiding rule; the applied prevent-addEventListener rule carries the argument 'catch' while the checkout's line 1899 carries ''. Live DOM confirms the mismatch:⁠ #⁠intro_container ⁠> div.instruction/.start-test-btn/.description and #⁠d3_wait_text, all matched by the checkout rules, are display:⁠block in the filtered baseline. Consequently apply_rule returned environmentExperiment=inconclusive, errorKind=baseline_symptom_absent, and the reported breakage cannot be reproduced or a fix verified. The run instruction declares no way (user rules, custom filter, or repo-built list) to load the repository's current rules into the validation session, so an incorrect-blocking fix for a rule newer than the pinned bundle can never be proven in this environment.

The ad that occupied the annotated region is yandex.com's own ad system:⁠ the loader https:⁠//yandex.com/ads/system/context.js is a first-party request (thirdParty=false in the HAR) and the unit is rendered inline in yandex.com's own DOM as `.DirectInline` inside `.MMSidebar-Card_bottomAdv`. The region's remaining blank space is the Yandex Images viewer's own side panel, not an ad container:⁠ `.ImagesViewer-LayoutSideblock` measures 960px in the unfiltered control, in the reporter profile and in the defaults_plus_required comparison, and the hidden card was only a flex child growing to fill it. Nothing element-hiding could remove remains (a DOM scan of the sidebar below y=230 returns zero elements), and shrinking the panel would require CSS injection that resizes the site's own layout, which the run instruction permits only when element hiding breaks layout or an intentional nonzero gap must be preserved. The ad container the reporter annotated is already removed on current lists by existing shared rules in the Russian filter (`ya.ru,yandex.*##.MMSidebar-Card_bottomAdv`, `ya.ru,yandex.*##.ImagesViewer-SidebarAdv`, antiadblock.txt lines 1443-1444), so no additional or extended rule is available to write.

comment.body:
Candidate rule proposed ## Reproduced symptom Reproduced — lycantoons.com shows a first-party anti-adblock wall ("Precisamos da sua ajuda … desative o bloqueador de anúncios") as a centered Chakra modal plus a full-viewport dimming/blur backdrop, reproduced on every load through the AdGuard CLI baseline even with the site's existing Spanish-filter rules applied. A domain-scoped element-hiding rule for both overlay layers was verified in the A/B/C experiment (wall gone, page readable, integrity intact). ## Rule `lycantoons.com##body > div:is(.css-1eciijn, .css-mpy1eg)` ## Policy rationale The run instruction's filter policy blocks rules for German anti-adblock walls, paywalls and first-party ads; this wall is Brazilian Portuguese, is not a paywall (the catalogue sits behind a blurred overlay), and is not first-party advertising, so none of those rules applies. For other anti-adblock walls the instruction allows a rule once the page's captured requests show the detector script:⁠ the captured requests contain the first-party detector/bait script https:⁠//lycantoons.com/ads.js and the ad-health driven overlay it feeds (artifact:⁠har:⁠f6edcffd-a8b2-4330-9115-b29624538139). The AdGuard filter policy permits blocking anti-adblock walls that aggressively insist on disabling the ad blocker or effectively prevent using the website; this modal dims and blurs the page, demands disabling the blocker and a reload, and offers only a paid VIP alternative. Maintainer guidance prefers hiding the popup over a scriptlet when hiding is enough, which the dismissal rehearsal and the verified apply_rule experiment confirm. ## Place in the list [SpanishFilter/sections/antiadblock.txt](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/f0e1dfd27e1622cc6069c5a332c6ab17ea0c4628/SpanishFilter/sections/antiadblock.txt) Next to the site's existing rules, before [line 136](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/f0e1dfd27e1622cc6069c5a332c6ab17ea0c4628/SpanishFilter/sections/antiadblock.txt#L136). ## Screenshots
Without and with the rule | Without the rule | With the rule | |---|---| | | |

issue.title: speedof.me: AdGuard Base rules hide mobile START TEST and results
issue.body: ### Prerequisites - [x] This site DOES NOT contain sexually explicit material, otherwise use [NSFW-specific form](./new?template=bug_report_NSFW.yml); - [x] Filters were updated before reproducing an issue; - [x] AdGuard product version is up-to-date; - [x] Browser version is up-to-date; - [x] If the site or app is broken, disabling AdGuard protection resolves an issue. ### What product do you use? AdGuard Browser Extension ### AdGuard version 5.5.3.3 (MV3 browser extension) ### What type of problem have you encountered? Website or app doesn't work properly ### Which browser(s) do you use? Chrome ### Which device do you use? Desktop ### Where is the problem encountered? https://speedof.me/m/ ### Ad Blocking AdGuard Base filter ### Privacy _No response_ ### Social Widgets _No response_ ### Annoyances AdGuard Cookie Notices filter, AdGuard Popups filter, AdGuard Other Annoyances filter ### Security _No response_ ### Other _No response_ ### DNS filters _No response_ ### Language-specific _No response_ ### What Stealth Mode options do you have enabled? _No response_ ### Add your comment and screenshots Hi, the recent filter changes associated with #245320 break the mobile speed test on SpeedOf.Me: https://speedof.me/m/ (build 3.205.2509). The START TEST control disappears, so visitors cannot start a speed test. With AdGuard disabled, the control is visible again. ### Rules responsible This rule hides the mobile START TEST control and the introductory text: ```text speedof.me###intro_container > div:not(.intro-group-container, .intro-dots) ``` This rule also matches the entire mobile results panel because `#result_container` is missing from its exceptions: ```text speedof.me##.middle-container > div:not(#progress_container, #share_container, #history_container, #intro_container) ``` ### Reproduction 1. Open https://speedof.me/m/ at a mobile viewport (390 × 844 in this reproduction). 2. Enable AdGuard with the filters listed above and the current published speedof.me rules. 3. Reload: the START TEST control and introductory text are missing. 4. Disable AdGuard and reload: START TEST and the introductory text return. Captured on October 28, 2026 using Chromium 143.0.7499.169 with AdGuard Browser Extension MV3 v5.5.3.3 at a mobile viewport. These are desktop Chrome captures of the mobile site, not captures from an Android or iOS device. Enabled filters: AdGuard Base 2.4.93.84, Cookie Notices 2.0.95.55, Popups 2.0.84.8, and Other Annoyances 2.0.48.76. The current published speedof.me rules from AdguardFilters revision `5a6d91f` were also loaded as user rules because bundled lists can lag the repository. No additional experimental blocking rules were used. Also reproduced with Chrome for Testing 156.0.8078.73 on macOS ARM64 at 390 × 844 using the same published rules. With only the intro-container rule exempted, START TEST returned and a real test completed, but the results panel and Repeat control remained hidden. Please revise the rules to preserve the START TEST control and mobile results panel. ### House promotions Separately, some placements promote SpeedOf.Me's own API, MCP integration, and connection certificate. These are promotions for the site's own services without third-party compensation. Could you review their treatment under the Base-filter policy concerning a site's own advertising? https://adguard.com/kb/general/ad-filtering/filter-policy/#limitations-and-exceptions Compensated affiliate offers have a different classification. ### Screenshots AdGuard enabled: START TEST and the introductory content are missing. AdGuard disabled: START TEST and the introductory content are visible. ### Privacy - [x] I agree to follow this condition

Analysis-only findings, no verified change

Fallback — Navigation timed out:⁠ Navigation did not complete after 1 attempt:⁠ https:⁠//www⁠.lapresse.ca/actualites/grand-montreal/2026-10-27/lignes-vaudreuil-hudson-et-candiac/jusqu-a-une-heure-de-retard-dans-les-trains-de-banlieue-mardi-matin.php (page.evaluate:⁠ Execution context was destroyed, most likely because of a navigation).

## Reproduced symptom

Indeterminate — The lapresse.ca report is a leftover translucent gray overlay (annotated in the reporter's screenshot) that no existing lapresse.ca rule covers, but the page could not be loaded for verification:⁠ a bot-verification interstitial (HTTP 202), then HTTP 405, then a navigation timeout exhausted the 3/3 browser attempts. Carrying the candidate `lapresse.ca##div:has(> div.brz_msg_wall_body)` in AnnoyancesFilter/Popups/sections/popups_specific.txt for human review, noting it must be checked against a paywall rather than a cookie-notice leftover.

## Candidate for review

`lapresse.ca##div:has(> div.brz_msg_wall_body)`

AnnoyancesFilter/Popups/sections/popups_specific.txt

Not verified: Browser access was exhausted:⁠ a French 'Human Verification' anti-bot interstitial (HTTP 202) replaced the article, a retry returned HTTP 405, and a materially different fresh session timed out (attempt 3/3). No apply_rule experiment or vision review could run, so there is no environmentExperiment verdict, no visualReview, and no page-integrity or residue observation. The selector is the reporter's hypothesis on a class never seen in a live DOM, so its match is unproven. A maintainer must confirm the gray band is that container and a cookie-notice leftover, not La Presse's paywall (policy bars rules for paywalls); if it is the Sourcepoint veil, check antiadblock.txt:⁠3572-3575 first.

## Missing information

- Reporter import URL cannot be applied in the locked adguard_cli environment: The issue carries a reporter settings Import URL (reports.adguard.com/settings/import.html?...filters=2.3.4...&⁠stealth.enabled=true...), and the run instruction says that when the raw issue contains one and the browser launch takes `settings`, the reporter profile must be `reported_on_current` with that URL and only such a session may verify a rule. After `select_environment` locked `adguard_cli`, launch_browser refused the settings payload:⁠ 'A control session (extension "none") runs no blocker and takes no "settings". Drop "settings" to launch the unfiltered control session, or pass extension "prepared" to launch the prepared blocker with these settings.' The instruction for this environment requires every evidence session to launch with extension "none", so the reporter profile could not be reproduced and the locked baseline stayed the host's official-filter set (with Bypass Paywalls Clean custom filter and third-party catalogs listed as skippedSources). The run needs explicit guidance for the reporter-import requirement in the adguard_cli route.

comment.body:
Candidate rule proposed ## Reproduced symptom Reproduced — hotel-roemmert.de shows its own Next.js consent card ("Werbemessung", data-consent-card) that the Cookie Notices filter does not cover; a domain-scoped hide rule for that stable attribute removed it in the verified A/B/C experiment with page integrity intact and no residue. ## Rule `hotel-roemmert.de##[data-consent-card]` ## Policy rationale The report is a cookie consent notice (annoyance), which is exactly the AdGuard Cookie Notices filter's purpose; it is not the site's own advertising, not a paywall, not a German anti-adblock wall and not a scam/phishing page, so no rule of the run instruction's filter policy closes or blocks it. ## Place in the list [AnnoyancesFilter/Cookies/sections/cookies_specific.txt](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/f0e1dfd27e1622cc6069c5a332c6ab17ea0c4628/AnnoyancesFilter/Cookies/sections/cookies_specific.txt) At the end of the file. ## Screenshots

The reported defect was not reproduced

## Reproduced symptom

Indeterminate — The reporter's annotated target is ntv.com.tr's cookie-consent bar, but on the loaded article page it is never rendered (display:⁠none, 0x0) both with the reporter's filter profile and with the AdGuard Cookie Notices filter removed, and full-page vision found it absent in both sessions. The repository already has a rule for that exact bar (AnnoyancesFilter/Cookies/sections/cookies_specific.txt:⁠2540), so no new rule is needed and the report can be closed as not reproduced.

## Policy rationale

The run instruction's filter policy closes first-party advertising, paywalls, German anti-adblock walls, unproven other anti-adblock walls and not-anti-adblock scam pages. None of those rules applies here:⁠ the report is an annoyance report about the site's cookie-consent bar, which the policy assigns to the AdGuard Cookie Notices filter. No policy rule blocks generation, so the report is open to rule generation; it is closed on reproduction grounds only, because the reported element is not rendered on the loaded page.

## Artifacts
